description: A link, good for 10 minutes, that opens the app the way the dashboard does: signed in as the person this computer is signed in as (usually its owner; `named: true`), or as an invited visitor nobody in particular when only the app's deploy key is here (`named: false`). Use it after a deploy to check a private app's signed-in pages and one upload yourself: open it in a browser tool, or with curl keep the cookies (`curl -sL -c jar -b jar "<url>"`, then `-b jar` on every later request to the app). Never paste the link into a chat or share it: anyone holding it can open the app as above until it expires.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: open_app
title: Open the app signed in
